en.cardTitle: TalkBack A11Y Auditor: linear Android audits with real gestures
en.cardDesc: Linear auditor for Android TalkBack with real swipe gestures via QEMU, spoken output capture via OCR, WebView DOM/ARIA inspection via Chrome CDP and interactive WCAG 2.2 reports.
en.cardAria: Read article about TalkBack A11Y Auditor

articles.article6-p1: TalkBack is the dominant screen reader on Android, but auditing with it manually requires precise gestures and attentive listening that does not scale. TalkBack A11Y Auditor automates that traversal inside a QEMU emulator, producing a linear report of what TalkBack actually announces on each element.
articles.article6-p2: Unlike static accessibility-tree inspections, the auditor injects real swipe gestures into the emulator, the same ones a user performs to move through the interface. This exposes problems the tree declares but the traversal never reaches: elements outside the focus order, unreachable regions or duplicated controls.
articles.article6-p3: The most original component is spoken-voice capture: TalkBack does not expose its output programmatically, so the auditor records the emulator's audio output and transcribes it via OCR/ASR to obtain the literal text of each announcement. That transcription is linked to the element focused at that instant.
articles.article6-p4: For embedded web content, the auditor connects to Android's WebView through Chrome DevTools Protocol and evaluates the DOM, ARIA roles and computed accessible names, the same way the NVDA auditor does on desktop. Cross-referencing the DOM against the verbalized output detects divergences between what the markup declares and what TalkBack pronounces.
articles.article6-p5: This auditor completes the ecosystem's trilogy: NVDA A11Y Auditor on Windows desktop, VoiceOver A11Y Auditor on iOS and TalkBack A11Y Auditor on Android. Running all three on the same interface reveals interpretation divergences between screen readers that no single-platform audit would detect.
articles.article6-p6: The project is open source and available at github.com/ingelectronicadj/talkback-a11y-auditor.
